threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look lost when the bus doesn't stop at the right stop, and you're waiting in that awkward half-hurry on Mare Street.
Last night, the 21 bus driver sang along to his playlist. Made the whole ride feel like a secret concert, even with the usual late-night crowd.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing Fußball in the street, while their parents chatted over coffee at an outdoor café, I felt like I finally belonged.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find spontaneous street parties where random DJs set up with just a generator and a couple of lights, no permits needed.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they complain about BART delays affecting their taco run at 10 PM – like it’s a personal attack on their late-night cravings.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today, and the driver blared 90s hip hop on the way up Mission. The whole bus was vibing, even the usual grumps were smiling.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gaudí is all there is to architecture here. They miss the hidden Modernista gems tucked in the side streets, like Casa Ramos.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their hesitation at the door of a bar, waiting for someone to show them a proper tapas order. Out of place, yet curious.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still pronounce 'Stoke Newington' like a tourist. Locals drop the 'Stoke' and just say 'Nin'ton' while sipping on a craft brew.
Last night on the 333, a bloke sang a whole operatic number. No one joined in, but we all clapped at the end. Only in Brixton, eh?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy fixing his bike while juggling a kebab and a coffee, I thought, yep, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a street art gallery that changes every week, with artists painting over each other's work. It's an ever-evolving canvas!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by how they navigate the bus schedule: they know the delays by heart and have a Plan B ready for the Muni meltdown.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo boarding the 27 while holding a pizza. Only in SF does a black-tie event mix with late-night munchies.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia’s plazas are just for picnics; locals know they're vibrant hubs for impromptu concerts and street performances every weekend.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the lack of napkins in restaurants. They’re still waiting for someone to bring them a proper stack.
